director_name.description: Name of the Director that is authorized to control this Storage Daemon. Must match the Director's Name.

director_password.description: Password used by the Director to authenticate to this Storage Daemon. Should be a strong secret.

storage_name.description: Unique identifier for this Storage Daemon (typically 'Storage' or a host-specific name like 'StorageNode1').

sd_port.description: TCP port on which the Storage Daemon listens for incoming connections.

sd_address.description: IP address the Storage Daemon binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces, or a specific IP for security.

working_directory.description: Directory for runtime files (e.g., .job, .status). Must be writable by the bacula-sd user.

pid_directory.description: Directory where the Storage Daemon writes its process ID file.

max_concurrent_jobs.description: Maximum number of backup/restore jobs the Storage Daemon can run concurrently.

device_name.description: Name of the primary backup device (e.g., for disk-based backups).

media_type.description: Type of media used by the primary device (e.g., 'File', 'LTO-6', 'DVD', 'Tape').

archive_device.description: Physical path to the backup storage (e.g., disk mount point or tape device like /dev/st0).

label_media.description: Whether Bacula should automatically label new volumes when needed.

random_access.description: Whether the device supports random access (true for disk, false for tape).

automatic_mount.description: Whether Bacula should automatically mount the device when needed (e.g., for tape changer operations).

removable_media.description: Whether the media is considered removable (e.g., tape, CD, DVD). Affects rotation and mount behavior.

always_open.description: Whether to keep the device open between jobs (performance optimization for some tape devices).

devices.description: List of additional storage devices (e.g., for multi-device or tape-library setups). Each device is a named configuration block.

label_media.description: Whether to auto-label media for this device.

random_access.description: Whether this device supports random access (true for disk, false for sequential media).

automatic_mount.description: Whether to auto-mount media for this device when needed.

removable_media.description: Whether this device uses removable media.

always_open.description: Whether to keep the device always open between jobs.

max_concurrent_jobs.description: Optional maximum concurrent jobs for this specific device (overrides the global default).

dev_extra.description: Optional list of extra key=value or directive strings for advanced tuning (e.g., ['AutoChanger = yes', 'SdPort = 9104']).
